- 1 \leq N, Q \leq 3 \times 10^5
- S is a string of length N consisting of lowercase English letters.
- l_i and r_i are integers.
- 1 \leq l_i \leq r_i \leq N

def solve():

        S = next(iterator)
    except StopIteration:

    # P[i] stores the number of adjacent duplicates in S[0...i] (0-based index i)
    # specifically, P[i] = count of indices k < i such that S[k] == S[k+1]
    # This allows range sum queries.
    # We want to query for range of p (0-based start of pair) from l-1 to r-2.
    # Sum is P[r-1] - P[l-1].
    # P has size N. P[0] = 0.
    
    P = [0] * N
    current_count = 0
    
    # Build prefix sum array
    # Iterate from 1 to N-1 to calculate P[1] to P[N-1]
    # Compare S[i-1] and S[i]
    for i in range(1, N):
        if S[i-1] == S[i]:
            current_count += 1
        P[i] = current_count
        
    results = []
